Subject: Post-call: HealTech discovery — next steps & rotating demo windows

Hi Sanjay / Alex —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

- Key needs: low-latency model inference for clinical suggestion workflows, VPC deployment for PHI, and predictable monthly committed capacity.
- Success criteria for the pilot: p95 latency < 120ms on 4k token sequences, integration with your KeyVault, and a reproducible perf/regression baseline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with our infra engineer (Ben) to walk through the integration / network requirements and run a short live inference test.
2) We set up a 3-week rotating demo window so your EU/APAC teams can join one of the recurring sessions outside US daytime. The pattern would alternate US-friendly and APAC-friendly times each week (details below).
3) I'll share a short agenda and a timeband matrix to make calendar matching quick.

Proposed rotating windows (select 1 preferred pattern):
- Option A (week A / week B): Tue 09:00-10:00 PT (US core) / Thu 22:00-23:00 PT (APAC friendly)
- Option B (week A / week B): Wed 13:00-14:00 PT (EU overlap) / Fri 03:00-04:00 PT (APAC late)

Can you confirm which option you'd prefer, and who should attend from your side besides Alex? Once you confirm, Ben and I will propose 3 recurring slots and send calendar invites.

Attachments: 2026-05-01_healtech_demo-agenda.pdf (agenda), healtech_timeband_matrix.csv (proposed slot matrix).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Hi Sanjay — happy to run the first session. Proposed plan for the 60-min deep dive:

- 0-10m: Intro + architecture alignment (Kim brings the high-level plan)
- 10-25m: Network & auth checklist (ports, IP allowlist, KMS/HSM integration)
- 25-40m: Live inference run against synthetic dataset (we'll demo p95 numbers and token throughput)
- 40-55m: Q&A on deployment variants (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)
- 55-60m: Next steps & action items (rollout timeline, pilot commit)

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Allowlist Redwood inference test IPs (I'll send a single CIDR block)
- SFTP or secure Drive where you can drop a small synthetic test payload (we'll use non-PHI data)
- Contact for KMS integration (name + email)

I'll attach the network checklist after this thread. For the schedule, Kimberly, can you pick the first date in the Week of May 11 we should lock (Tue 09:00 PT looks good on our side)?
